title: Hastings's nuclear-site UFO whistleblowers

tellings.quote: I have data of around, you know, again, 167 plus whistleblowers who are at nuclear sites all over the country coming from this guy Robert Hastings.

plain: More than 167 people who worked at nuclear sites across the United States have come forward to say they saw UFOs there, according to records gathered by a researcher named Robert Hastings. Michels raises this himself on his show in 2026, citing Hastings's collection as his data. Told this way, it would mean UFOs have taken a steady interest in American nuclear weapons.
